page_title: WER 2-3 HOF | Werder Bremen v Hoffenheim 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
90+9' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
90+8' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) brings an opponent down and Christian Dingert interrupts the game.
90+7' The corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+7' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call.
90+5' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+2' 2 - 3 Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) launches an excellent first-time shot from the edge of the box and the ball goes straight into the bottom left corner. A special shot.
90+2' A yellow card for bad language! Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

90+1' 2 - 2 Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:2.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
88' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but it's cleared.
87' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
86' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Rafael Borre, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
85' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) will replace Marco Friedl.
83' Pavel Kaderabek clips a neat ball into the box towards Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
81' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) replaces Florian Grillitsch.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Maximilian Beier.
81' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
79' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the left post.
79' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes a direct free kick.

77' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Oliver Baumann was alert and the score remained the same.
76' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) is penalised for holding. Christian Dingert signals a set piece.
75' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
72' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Senne Lynen will be replaced by Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
72' It will be a substitution. Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolai Rapp walks off.
72' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
72' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
70' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
69' The game is interrupted. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
69' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
67' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
66' Pellegrino Matarazzo is forced to make a change. Ozan Kabak is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim).
65' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

64' What a wasted opportunity by Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Jiri Pavlenka makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
62' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
62' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' Substitution. Robert Skov walks off the pitch and Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
59' Here is a change. Justin Njinmah is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
59' It is time for a substitution. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is on for Naby Keita.
58' Nicolai Rapp (Werder Bremen) is the one who receives a yellow card.
57' Hoffenheim couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jiri Pavlenka (Werder Bremen) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
56' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
55' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
52' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
49' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Christian Dingert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Christian Dingert blows his whistle after Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+1' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it goes over the bar by a whisker.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
41' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
37' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is caught offside!
35' Werder Bremen are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
32' Naby Keita (Werder Bremen) earns the yellow card.
29' 1 - 2 Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
26' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.
24' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
24' A cross from Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
21' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
19' Referee Christian Dingert signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Werder Bremen players have a reason to celebrate!
18' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Werder Bremen players aren’t happy.
17' 1 - 1 Goal! Marvin Ducksch passes the ball to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Oliver Baumann couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
14' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
14' A lofted cross from Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

10' Werder Bremen players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.

8' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Grischa Promel releases Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 0:1.
5' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Christian Dingert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
